$comment: Copy to seek/profile.json (gitignored) and fill it in. Every letter, CV and form answer is written from this file and your CVs alone — never invented. Leave a field out rather than guess.

identity.bio: data analyst with 4 years in fintech, Python and SQL, open to remote roles

authorization.rule: Authorized to work in Kenya. Needs sponsorship elsewhere.

skills.$comment: Yes/no experience questions are answered from these lists only; anything unlisted is held for you to answer.

answers.match: why do you want to work
answers.answer: One or two honest sentences you are happy to reuse.

seek.strategy: What you want first and why — e.g. remote data roles that hire from Kenya, then Nairobi on-site roles; skip US-only postings.
seek.tailorRules: How a CV may present your record — which experience leads for which kind of role, dates to write exactly, certificates never to overstate.

sweep.brief: Use WebSearch (and WebFetch to read postings) to find OPEN data analyst and BI roles that are remote-from-Kenya or in Nairobi. Run at least 10 searches, e.g. "data analyst job Nairobi", "remote data analyst Africa {month}", "site:brightermonday.co.ke data analyst". Prefer the employer's own posting page. Drop roles restricted to other nationals.
sweep.campaignGuide: Use remote-data-analyst for remote roles and nairobi-data-analyst for on-site Nairobi roles.
